purpose: Research only. No live trade orders. Trading PnL after costs, no rebate/backcom.

candles.atr: SMA of last 14 completed true ranges, not Wilder
candles.ema: pandas adjust=False equivalent, computed from completed close values

swap: Prohibit overnight holds: no entry after 16:00 UTC; hard flat at 17:00 UTC before Exness rollover. Record swap=0 for all genuinely same-day trades; if an exceptional trade crosses rollover, mark invalid and require historical per-day broker swap data instead of imputing zero.

fill_policy.reference_quote: first quote whose timestamp is at or after signal-or-trigger time plus latency
fill_policy.stop_tp: Evaluate on actual bid for long and actual ask for short; stop wins if both appear to trigger on same quote; market exit at first eligible quote after latency, not guaranteed stop price.
fill_policy.spread_stress: Hold mid fixed; bid_stress=mid-(original_spread*factor)/2; ask_stress=mid+(original_spread*factor)/2. Keep signals based on unperturbed mid candles.

position_policy.margin_formula: 0.01*100000*EURUSD_price/200 in USD; check free margin and equity > 0, no additional deposits; reject otherwise.
position_policy.stop_out: equity <= 0 forces liquidating; no negative balance protection assumed
position_policy.risk_cap: estimated SL loss + 2 side slippage + spread must be <= 2% current equity; skip otherwise

spread_filter: At signal and entry: spread <= 0.40 * ATR14 and spread <= 0.30 * planned gross TP distance; skip otherwise

stop_target.anchoring: SL and TP anchored to the actual filled entry price

S1_Candle_Pressure.long: For last 3 fully closed candles P=sum(close-open)/sum(abs(close-open)); P >= +0.65, final body/range >= 0.55, and (final close-low)/(high-low) >= 0.70
S1_Candle_Pressure.short: Mirror: P <= -0.65, final body/range >= 0.55, final close location <= 0.30

S2_Micro_Range_Breakout.long: Signal candle close > max(high of 12 candles strictly before signal candle)+0.15*ATR14 and signal candle open <= that max; signal close location >= 0.70
S2_Micro_Range_Breakout.short: Signal candle close < min(low of 12 candles strictly before signal candle)-0.15*ATR14 and signal candle open >= that min; signal close location <= 0.30

S3_Micro_Trend_Pullback.long: EMA9 > EMA21, EMA9 > EMA9 three candles earlier, preceding candle low <= its EMA9 and preceding candle close > its EMA21, current close > preceding high and current close > its EMA9
S3_Micro_Trend_Pullback.short: Mirror: EMA9 < EMA21, EMA9 < EMA9 3 candles earlier, preceding high >= preceding EMA9 and preceding close < preceding EMA21, current close < preceding low and current close < its EMA9

validation.walk_forward: 6 whole calendar months training; next 1 whole month out-of-sample; roll 1 month each fold. First OOS=2025-07; last complete OOS=2026-10. Never include partial 2026-11 in final accept/reject.
validation.candidate_universe: S1,S2,S3 x M1,M5 x stop_atr(1.2,1.8) x reward_r(1.5,2.2) = 24 candidates, immutable grid
validation.training_select: For each strategy/timeframe choose among 4 combinations in the immediately prior 6 months; must have >=30 completed trades, PF>1.0 and expectancy>0. Select highest training expectancy; if none, no trade in that OOS month. Train and evaluate each strategy/timeframe independently.
validation.primary_selection: At most one strategy + timeframe. Require total OOS net USD > 0, PF >=1.15, >=200 OOS trades, positive net in each of OOS 2025 and 2026, >=60% profitable OOS months with trades, daily-block bootstrap 95% lower CI of mean trade PnL >0, and net positive under both spread/slippage stress scenarios and 300ms model. Rank those passing by stressed OOS net USD. If none pass report NO EDGE.
validation.data_quality: Must verify ZIP/CSV content and UTC ms timestamps, positive bid/ask, ask>=bid, ordered ticks, duplicate handling, missing days and market closure, full 2025 and all completed months of 2026. On any missing or untrusted months return INCOMPLETE not zero fills.
validation.data_leakage_policy: No thresholds may be changed after this file is hashed; performance discovered during implementation cannot change rules. Any bugfix must be versioned with new SHA, never claim same frozen version.
